tasks.label: Prepare route directories
args: const { mkdirSync } = require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['apps/web/src/components/investors', 'apps/web/src/components/desktop-agent', 'apps/web/src/app/[locale]/investors', 'apps/web/src/app/[locale]/desktop-agent']) mkdirSync(path, { recursive: true });
